audit.source: Lighthouse 12.8.2 and a public HTML fetch of https://shop.warnerrecords.com/. No login. The store was not changed. PageSpeed Insights returned HTTP 429 without an API key, so field INP is not included. Lab TBT is the blocking-time proxy.
audit.fieldNote: INP is a field metric and was not returned. Lab TBT is shown instead.
audit.uxNote: Scores, Web Vitals, and screenshots are the real public Shopify store. The device funnel is demo data.

issues.title: Homepage largest paint is slow on both form factors
issues.detail: Lab LCP is 8.7s on mobile (performance 41) and 9.0s on desktop (performance 27). TBT is 1417ms mobile and 1108ms desktop. TTFB is 18ms, so the wait is in the page, not the server.

issues.title: Collection pages and the cart have no meta description
issues.detail: Empty descriptions on /collections/vinyl, /collections/music, /collections/apparel, /collections/best-sellers, /cart. Lighthouse flags meta-description on the vinyl collection and the cart. The homepage and product pages do have descriptions.

issues.title: Cart and search shift layout
issues.detail: CLS is at least 0.1 on collection desktop 0.121; search desktop 0.155; cart mobile 0.148; cart desktop 0.198. Homepage mobile CLS is 0.

issues.title: Collections do not publish Collection or breadcrumb schema
issues.detail: Product pages include Product schema (brand, GTIN, image). Collection pages in this sample only include Organization. No BreadcrumbList was found.

issues.title: Some images ship an empty alt attribute
issues.detail: Across the sampled pages, 25 images have alt="". The homepage H1 is the logo image (alt Warner Records), not a text heading.

issues.title: Search results are noindex, which is why their SEO score is lower
issues.detail: The vinyl search URL sends X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow. That is a reasonable choice. It is not a broken title. The cart does not send noindex.

issues.title: Search and cart in the header are icon-only
issues.detail: The public homepage screenshot shows Music, Apparel, and Best Sellers as text, and search and cart as icons. On a phone that is easy to miss.

fixes.title: Shrink the homepage hero and the main-thread work so LCP gets under 2.5s.
Write a unique meta description for each collection, and noindex the cart.
Reserve space for cart and search modules so CLS stays under 0.1.
Add CollectionPage and BreadcrumbList schema, and fill empty image alts.
Give the header search and cart a visible label on small screens.
In the demo keyword model, the largest queries are branded vinyl and Zach Bryan. Give those a landing path. This is not a Search Console rank.

demoModel.label: DEMO DATA
demoModel.note: Not from Search Console or Analytics. Clicks and revenue allocate this dashboard’s synthetic Shopify Organic Search. The device rows allocate filtered Shopify DTC orders. Shares are fixed (seed 20261027): mobile is 71% of sessions, 62% of orders, and 56% of net revenue, so desktop conversion and AOV come out higher.
